summary.text: Rebecca Kassay is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly representing District 4, which she has represented since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kassay was born in Stony Brook, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York, New Paltz in 2010.
Her career experience includes working in public service.
As of 2024, she was affiliated with the Rotary Club of Port Jefferson, Montessori Model United Nations, and the Port Jefferson Chamber of Commerce.
